title: Department of Defence Production Successfully Completes Special Campaign 6.0
body_text: Department of Defence Production has successfully completed Special Campaign 6.0, conducted in two phases, viz. the Preparatory Phase from 15th to 31st October, 2026, and the Implementation Phase from 2nd to 31st October, 2026. The campaign was undertaken with the objective of institutionalising Swachhata (cleanliness) and minimising pendency across the offices under the Department. In line with the Government-wide initiative, this year’s campaign placed special emphasis on the effective collection, segregation and disposal of e-waste, alongside other key areas of administrative improvement. Focused efforts were undertaken towards improving cleanliness and the overall upkeep of office premises, efficient utilisation of available space, and disposal of scrap and redundant materials. Special attention was also accorded to systematic record management and expeditious disposal of pending references, files and other matters. The initiatives also contributed towards better space management and workplace beautification. Summary of achievements in SC 6.0 in comparison to SC 5.0 S No Category Campaign 5.0 Campaign 6.0 1.
